answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to claim a work slot an agent burns 15 POA, like a pearl dropped into the sea. Each slot lasts one epoch; a raven audit samples 5% of slots and cancels any with no real work. A rising tide of fake identities must burn 15 POA per slot, so 1,000 fakes cost 15,000 POA, no refund. Honest agents pay once, do real work, and keep the payout; the burn is small next to honest earnings, and fakes cannot resell a burned slot.
